connection.noPortsHelp: On Linux make sure your user is in the dialout group and that the correct udev rules are installed for CH340/FTDI.
connection.baudHelp: Use 115200 for Unihedron + most DIY ESP8266 SQM firmwares.

configuration.title: Configuration & Calibration
configuration.description: Adjust the device's internal logging interval and light/dark calibration registers (zcal5/6/7/8, zcalAx/Bx/Dx).
configuration.loggingIntervalDesc: Persisted on the device (Unihedron Lxxxxxxxxx command).
configuration.rtcDesc: Reads on-device clock (Lcx) and trigger settings (Lmx, LIx). For SQM-LU-DL models.
configuration.calibrationDesc: Arm light/dark calibration requires the official reference source (use Disarm to cancel). Direct setters write to the device's permanent memory.

configuration.confirmCalCmd: Send calibration command '{action}' to the device?
configuration.confirmWrite: Write these calibration values to the device permanent memory?

firmware.title: Firmware (DIY SQM only)
firmware.description: Flash ESP8266 / ESP32 firmware on a DIY SQM via esptool. Official Unihedron SQM-LU/LE/DL devices use a different (PIC) firmware procedure that is not yet supported here.
firmware.supportedList: DIY SQM ESP8266 NodeMCU (CH340), ESP32 / ESP8266 boards (CP210x, PL2303). Uses esptool to write a .bin file at offset 0x0.
firmware.notSupportedList: Official Unihedron SQM-LU / SQM-LE / SQM-LU-DL. Their PIC firmware uses the proprietary HEX-over-serial bootloader (x4x5x6x) which requires a different implementation — coming on the roadmap.
firmware.switchTitle: DIY SQM — 3-position front switch (e.g. SQM Pro ESP8266)
firmware.switchIntro: Many ESP8266-based DIY SQM PCBs (including SQM Pro) use a 3-position center-off SPDT switch:
firmware.switchCenter: Center — normal Wi-Fi mode (default, pushes data to dashboard)
firmware.switchD5: D5 / GPIO14 — Unihedron USB mode (answers ix, rx, cx… serial commands — connect via Find USB)
firmware.switchD3: D3 / GPIO0 — Flash boot mode (ESP8266 bootloader — only this position works for re-flashing)
firmware.switchHow: To flash: set the switch to the D3 (Flash boot) position, replug or press RST, then press Start flash below. Set it back to D5 (Unihedron USB) to talk to UDM Fork, or Center for normal Wi-Fi operation.
firmware.uploadDesc: Drop a .bin or .hex file to stage it for flashing.
firmware.stagedHint: Staged files are kept under SQM_FIRMWARE_DIR.
firmware.flashDesc: Targets the currently-connected port. The serial connection will be closed first.
firmware.confirmFlash: Flash {name} via esptool to the connected port?
firmware.githubReleasesDesc: Download prebuilt .bin files directly from the official repo.

console.serialTerminalDesc: Bytes are sent verbatim (no automatic newline). Use the presets for common commands.
console.noIO: No I/O yet. Try a preset above.

dashboard.emptyDesc: Connect your SQM Pro and click "Auto-detect", or enter your SensorID manually below.
dashboard.toastSensorNotFound: Could not detect a SensorID from the device (firmware not compatible?).
dashboard.iframeBlocked: The remote server may block iframe display (X-Frame-Options). Use "Open in new tab" if the preview stays empty.

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.description: Customize language, appearance and SQM configuration.
settings.nightVisionDesc: Switch the interface to dark red to preserve dark adaptation.
settings.dashboardSyncDesc: Configure the SensorID used on sqm.quentin-astro.fr.
settings.aboutDesc: Information about this UDM Fork installation.
settings.smoothingDesc: Anti-jitter settings for DIY sensors. Increasing the polling interval and the smoothing window produces much more stable values.
settings.pollIntervalDesc: Time between two 'rx' requests sent to the device. Longer = more stable but less responsive.
settings.smoothNDesc: Number of samples averaged for the main display cards. The chart still keeps raw data points.

help.title: Help & Troubleshooting
help.description: Quick reference for the UDM Fork, supported devices and Linux setup.
help.aboutForkDesc: Modern web UI replacing the original UDM tkinter app.
help.aboutP1: UDM Fork is an open-source rewrite of the Unihedron Device Manager (UDM) for the Sky Quality Meter, with one key addition: USB discovery now also recognises DIY SQM devices based on the ESP8266 NodeMCU (CH340 driver).
help.aboutP2: It speaks the Unihedron serial protocol (115200 8N1, commands ix, rx, ux, cx, Lxxxxxxxxx, zcalAx, etc.).
help.supportedAdaptersDesc: Detected by VID/PID and shown in the Find USB panel.
help.sqmProFwDesc: Open-source firmware that pairs with UDM Fork via the Unihedron-compatible serial protocol.
help.sqmProFwIntro: If you're looking for a tested DIY firmware that works out of the box with UDM Fork (CH340 detection, ix/rx/cx/w/g commands, TSL2591 light sensor, BME280 weather, OLED, optional GPS NEO-6, OTA, deep-sleep, Wi-Fi push), have a look at SQM Pro by Quentin Dumont:
help.sqmProHardware: Hardware: ESP8266 NodeMCU + Adafruit TSL2591 + BME280 + SH1106/SSD1306 OLED + optional u-blox NEO-6M GPS. Baud rate 115200 (SQM-LU compatible since firmware v2.2.4).
help.q1: I can't open the serial port (Permission denied)
help.a1: Add your user to the dialout group:
help.q2: CH340 not detected or detected as ttyUSB but unreachable
help.q3: ModemManager keeps grabbing my serial port
help.a3: Disable it (it interferes with SQM/ESP8266 serial):
help.a4: Install esptool: pip install esptool. Then ensure your DIY SQM is in bootloader mode (some boards need GPIO0 held to GND on reset).

sqmpro.weatherDesc: BME280 / TSL2591 data reported by the firmware (w command).
sqmpro.gpsDesc: GPS position and time (g command) — optional NEO-6M module.
sqmpro.noWeather: No weather data. Does the firmware support it?
sqmpro.noGps: No GPS data. Module present and fixed?
sqmpro.calDesc: DIY firmware specific commands (zcal1 / zcal2 / zcal3 / A50…A5e). Auto-detected from g read-config response.
